payload.summary: Extend roadmap.ticket-grilling-self-resolved: a LATER human-attributed note carrying ticket=<id> for the flagged ticket counts as post-hoc human ratification and clears the warning (DD6-symmetric, append-only-native — sources on a resolved ticket cannot be added retroactively). Motivation: the check's first live run flags all 16 planning-partner grill resolutions — visualjc's rulings were relayed under the agent actor, so no human-attributed source exists. Design detail: one note per ticket vs one note naming several.
